topic: Reinstating facility loading for large clients
summary_markdown:
The discussion centered on the functionality of filtering and loading facilities. It was noted that when clients with 1000+ facilities were added, the system's loading mechanism was changed to load data in parts (chunking).

[p1] suggested potentially restoring the full loading capability for specific clients, mentioning 'JCD Litva'. [me] agreed to discuss this internally and advised [p1] on how to communicate the technical change—that the partial loading was implemented due to large client loads.

It was decided that a ticket should be created regarding this issue.
decisions: A support ticket will be created concerning the facility loading mechanism.
action_items: [me] needs to discuss the feasibility of restoring full facility loading with 'Sanya'.
